About ▸ Data sources

FRED (St. Louis Fed)ready

US Treasury curve 1M-30Y and TIPS, global policy rates, monetary aggregates, inflation, ICE BofA corporate yield and OAS spread indexes

Licence / terms: Public domain for Federal Reserve data; third-party series (ICE BofA) are copyrighted, FRED shows a rolling 3-year window, attribution required

Rate limit: 20/min · no key

OpenFIGIready

Free mapping tier: FIGI, name, ticker, exchange, market sector and security type for bond and equity identifiers (ISIN, CUSIP, ticker)

Licence / terms: FIGI is an open standard (MIT-licensed data, Bloomberg as registration authority); API terms of use apply

Rate limit: 25/min · no key

Financial Modeling Prepneeds key

Standardised annual fundamentals and ratios (margins, returns, leverage, valuation multiples) for US equities

Licence / terms: FMP terms of service: free tier for personal, non-commercial use; attribution

Rate limit: 5/min, 250/day · free key

Status: FMP needs a free API key: none is configured in the fleet secret store (FMP_API_KEY) for the container, or in Config > Sources (fmp) on this phone

SEC EDGARready

Filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) with links, and XBRL company facts (revenue, net income, EPS, assets, equity, operating cash flow)

Licence / terms: US government work, public domain; SEC fair-access policy (declared User-Agent with a contact, at most 10 requests a second)

Rate limit: 10/s · no key

Yahoo Finance (chart)off

EOD prices (open, high, low, close), splits and dividends for symbols no other source serves

Licence / terms: No official API; Yahoo's terms restrict automated use (ToS risk): off by default, last fallback only, our own honest User-Agent (no spoofing)

Rate limit: 10/min · no key

Status: feature flag FINTERM_YAHOO is off; last fallback after cboe, fred, coinbase
